09-regression:1e8dae63d9ccdcd5aa36.label: known-regression
09-regression:1e8dae63d9ccdcd5aa36.reason: The route takes activity actor userId from the body instead of authenticated context. An authenticated caller with task-update permission can attribute activity to a different existing user.

10-regression:e2d02ffd2eedf2f3b32f.label: false-positive
10-regression:e2d02ffd2eedf2f3b32f.reason: A real workspace-authorization regression is present, but the published trigger and consequence are materially wrong. apps/api/src/index.ts runs authenticateApiRequest before mounting githubIntegration. Unauthenticated requests are rejected. The list response also does not contain the claimed permissions and installation_id fields. Do not credit a correct root-cause fragment as a fully correct finding.

10-regression:65afa3f6fe4316ea0069.label: additional-valid
10-regression:65afa3f6fe4316ea0069.reason: The separate POST /verify route loses its project membership and manage_settings checks. A signed-in user without those permissions can now query installation verification information. This is a second endpoint consequence, beyond the manifest target of repository enumeration; global authentication still applies.
